settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders ship from our studio within two working days. Delivery takes 2 to 4 days within Java and 3 to 7 days elsewhere in Indonesia. Shipping is free on orders over $75.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange something?
settings.answer: Yes. Unworn pieces with their tags can be returned or exchanged within 30 days. Start a return from the contact page and we will send you a label.

settings.question: How do your clothes fit?
settings.answer: Most pieces are cut relaxed. Every product page has a size guide with garment measurements. If you are between sizes, take the larger one for a looser fit.

settings.question: Is the fabric really handmade?
settings.answer: Yes. Our lurik and tenun are woven on hand-operated looms, and our batik is stamped by hand with copper tools. Small irregularities in stripe, colour and pattern are part of the cloth, not defects.

settings.question: How should I wash it?
settings.answer: Wash cold, inside out, and dry in the shade. Indigo pieces should be washed separately for the first few washes. Each product page lists its own care instructions.

settings.question: Why does my piece look slightly different from the photo?
settings.answer: Natural dyes and hand weaving make every batch a little different. We photograph real pieces, but expect small shifts in shade and stripe placement.

settings.question: Who makes the cloth?
settings.answer: Family workshops in Klaten, Troso and Pekalongan. You can meet them on our Our Craft page, and each product page names the maker behind it.
